name: ss2ntk_odps_202601_04
sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目名称 : 星矢东南亚、星矢繁体、新三国 2026年 1-4月 月度 KPI 统计 SQL
数据源   : 阿里云 MaxCompute (ODPS)
核心数据表: dm_platform.daily_lcx_user_info (平台全量 DAU/MAU、注册与付费汇总表)
数据说明 : 
  - 统计时间范围: 2025-12-01 至 2026-04-30 (包含 2025-12 以计算 2026-01 月留存)
  - 去水条件: is_water = '不是水'
  - 适用游戏与 App ID:
      * 星矢繁体 (Saint Seiya TC)   : app_id = 23000113
      * 星矢东南亚 (Saint Seiya SEA) : app_id = 60000001
      * 新三国 (New Three Kingdoms)  : app_id = 65002004
================================================================================
*/

SET odps.sql.hive.compatible = TRUE;

WITH RawUserInfo AS (
    -- 1. 从平台全量用户日活表 dm_platform.daily_lcx_user_info 提取基础登录与付费数据
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(app_id AS STRING) IN ('23000113') THEN '星矢繁体'
            WHEN CAST(app_id AS STRING) IN ('60000001') THEN '星矢东南亚'
            WHEN CAST(app_id AS STRING) IN ('65002004') THEN '新三国'
        END AS game,
        SUBSTR(CAST(day AS STRING), 1, 6) AS ym_str,
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(CAST(day AS STRING), 1, 4), '-', SUBSTR(CAST(day AS STRING), 5, 2)) AS month,
        SUBSTR(CAST(reg_day AS STRING), 1, 6) AS reg_ym_str,
        CAST(lcm_id AS STRING) AS lcm_id,
        COALESCE(purchase, 0.0) AS daily_purchase
    FROM dm_platform.daily_lcx_user_info
    WHERE CAST(app_id AS STRING) IN ('23000113', '60000001', '65002004')
      AND (is_water IS NULL OR is_water = '不是水')
      AND day BETWEEN 20251201 AND 20260430
),

MonthlyActiveUsers AS (
    -- 2. 按月统计活跃用户 (区分 NUU 当月新注册用户 与 老用户)
    SELECT
        game,
        month,
        lcm_id,
        CASE WHEN reg_ym_str = ym_str THEN 'NUU' ELSE 'OLD' END AS user_type,
        SUM(daily_purchase) AS monthly_user_purchase
    FROM RawUserInfo
    WHERE game IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY game, month, lcm_id, CASE WHEN reg_ym_str = ym_str THEN 'NUU' ELSE 'OLD' END
),

MonthlyAgg AS (
    -- 3. 统计当月 MAU、NUU、老用户数、当月总流水 RMB 与 NUU 新用户流水 RMB
    SELECT
        game,
        month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lcm_id) AS mau,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type = 'NUU' THEN lcm_id END) AS nuu,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type = 'OLD' THEN lcm_id END) AS old_users,
        SUM(monthly_user_purchase) AS sales_rmb,
        SUM(CASE WHEN user_type = 'NUU' THEN monthly_user_purchase ELSE 0 END) AS nuu_sales_rmb
    FROM MonthlyActiveUsers
    GROUP BY game, month
),

JoinedMonthlyKPI AS (
    -- 4. 关联上月 MAU 计算月度留存比例
    SELECT
        game,
        month,
        sales_rmb,
        mau,
        nuu,
        nuu_sales_rmb,
        old_users,
        LAG(mau, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY game ORDER BY month ASC) AS prev_mau
    FROM MonthlyAgg
)

-- 5. 最终指标输出 (只显示 2026-01 至 2026-04，2026-01 的留存率通过 2025-12 MAU 正确计算)
SELECT
    game AS game,
    month AS month,
    ROUND(sales_rmb, 2) AS sales_rmb,
    mau AS mau,
    nuu AS nuu,
    ROUND(nuu_sales_rmb, 2) AS nuu_sales_rmb,
    ROUND(nuu_sales_rmb * 100.0 / NULLIF(sales_rmb, 0), 2) AS nuu_ratio,
    ROUND(nuu_sales_rmb / NULLIF(nuu, 0), 2) AS nuu_arpu_rmb,
    old_users AS old_users,
    ROUND(old_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_mau, 0), 2) AS old_retention_ratio,
    ROUND((sales_rmb - nuu_sales_rmb) / NULLIF(old_users, 0), 2) AS old_arpu_rmb
FROM JoinedMonthlyKPI
WHERE month >= '2026-01'
ORDER BY game, month;
